A young woman with red hair, wearing a blue patterned top and grey shorts, stands on the right raising one hand high. Next to her, an older woman in a blue checkered vest and long tan skirt replicates the pose. (2) Transition to a geothermal area at Te Puia with steam rising from vents. The younger woman now wears a purple shirt and pink jacket, while the older woman wears a white shirt; both maintain the same hand-raising pose. (3) The pair stands on a wooden pier in front of a blue and white seaplane. The younger woman wears a yellow and black striped shirt, while the older woman is in a tan vest. (4) They are now in a lush green forest area wearing orange safety helmets and ziplining harnesses, both raising their hands toward the sky. (5) On the deck of a boat with forested hills and water in the background, the pair continues their synchronized hand-raising pose. (6) They walk along a gravel path lined with purple lavender bushes near the Harvest Restaurant; the lighting is warm and natural from the sun. (7) In front of a large white building, they perform a synchronized dance move, stepping and turning in unison. (8) At the Te Puia Maori cultural site on a red carpet, the older woman playfully grabs the younger woman's neck in a mock choking gesture, both laughing as the video ends.
